name: Annual Gifted Education Awareness Notice
description: Awareness activities informing resident parents of gifted services and how to request them, e.g., notices in newspapers, handbooks and the District website.
recipient: Parents / guardians of school-aged children residing in the District
quote: The Superintendent or designee shall annually conduct awareness activities to inform parents/guardians of school-aged children residing within the District of its gifted education services and programs, and how to request these services and programs.
